svg.text: Comprehensive Side-by-Side Benchmark: Decompression & Compression Throughput and Ratios

g.text: CPU: Apple M2 Max (12 Cores: 8 Performance @ 3.68GHz + 4 Efficiency @ 2.42GHz)
OS: macOS Sequoia ｜ Toolchain: Rust 1.98 / LLVM Clang (-O3)

svg.text: Evaluated across 31 real-world physical, financial, weather datasets (Metrics calculated using Geometric Mean)

g.text: All 31 Benchmark Datasets Individual Comparison (fastalp vs C++ ALP)
Full breakdown of compression ratios, decompression throughputs, and speedup multipliers

svg.text: Covering IoT telemetry, physical monotonic waveforms, high-frequency finance, and steady constants

g.text: NEON/NOAA air pressure, temperature, water level (1024 pts)
Monotonic ramp, USGS river discharge & river stage (1024 pts)
High-frequency trade prices: US, DE, UK stocks (1024 pts)
Fixed-range sensors, error-free health monitoring (1024 pts)

svg.text: Note: Overall decode/encode speeds and compression ratios are calculated using Geometric Mean across all 31 datasets. Measured directly on Apple M2 Max with C++ ALP official source. Exact IEEE 754 bitwise lossless.
